en.name: Fried fish cake
en.summary: Fried fish cake — 甜不辣 in Taiwan, satsuma-age in Japan — is surimi shaped and deep-fried, sold chilled for soups and hotpot. Once opened it keeps 3–4 days in the fridge and 1–2 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: These are chilled cooked foods, not shelf snacks, and the fried surface is not a barrier. Fish paste products are moist, low in salt and fully cooked, which is exactly the profile that supports bacterial growth once the pack is opened. Follow the printed date while the pack is sealed, keep them at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and observe the 2-hour rule when they are out, or 1 hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A tray left out on a night-market counter is being sold for that evening, not stored.
en.fridge: Once the pack is opened this is simply cooked fish paste: keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a covered box and finish it within 3–4 days, which is the published figure for cooked fish. The pack date covers the unopened pack, not the leftover half, so do not go on trusting it after you have cut into it. Cook the pieces through in soup rather than just warming them, and discard any surface that has gone slimy rather than trimming it.
en.freezer: Fried fish cake freezes acceptably for 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F), coming out spongier than it went in because the fried crust takes up water on thawing. Slice or portion it first, freeze in a single layer on a tray so the pieces do not fuse, then bag them flat. Cook straight from frozen in soup or hotpot — that is where the slightly spongier texture disappears. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
en.thawing: Drop the pieces into simmering broth straight from the freezer. If you do thaw them, do it in the fridge, cook them that day, and do not refreeze.
spoilage: A slimy or sticky surface, or pieces sticking together in a wet mass.
A sour or fermented smell instead of a mild fried-fish one.
A puffed, gassy pack, or liquid pooling in the bag.
Any mould, or a rancid, paint-like smell from the frying oil.
tips: Buy from a chilled cabinet, not a room-temperature tray.
Decant an opened pack into a covered box and note the date.
Freeze in portions on a tray first, then bag.
Cook through in soup rather than just warming the pieces.

faq.q: How long does fried fish cake keep once opened?
faq.a: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a covered box. An unopened pack goes by its printed date.

faq.q: Can you freeze fried fish cake?
faq.a: Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C. It comes out spongier, so cook it straight from frozen in soup or hotpot.

faq.q: Is the fried surface a protective layer?
faq.a: No. It is just fried batter and paste; the moist, low-salt interior still needs refrigeration.

faq.q: How can you tell if fried fish cake has gone off?
faq.a: A slimy surface, a sour smell, a gassy pack, or a rancid note from the oil. Discard rather than trimming.

zh.name: 甜不辣
zh.summary: 甜不辣（日本的薩摩揚げ）是魚漿塑形後油炸而成的冷藏熟食，常用在湯品和火鍋。開封後冷藏可放 3～4 天，冷凍 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 這是冷藏熟食，不是常溫零食，而且油炸表面並不是屏障。魚漿製品含水高、鹽分低、又是全熟品，正是包裝拆開後最容易長菌的條件。包裝完好時依標示日期，放 4 °C 以下，離開冰箱後守 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。夜市攤上擺著的那盤，是「今晚要賣掉」，不是在做保存。
zh.fridge: 包裝一拆開，它就只是熟的魚漿：加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下，3～4 天內用完，這是「熟魚」的公告值。包裝日期涵蓋的是未開封的整包，不是切開後剩下的半包，所以拆封之後就不要再依賴它。要吃請在湯裡確實煮透，不要只是加熱；表面一旦發黏，請整塊丟棄而不是切掉一層。
zh.freezer: 甜不辣在 −18 °C 下可放 1～2 個月，表現尚可，解凍後會比原本更海綿，因為炸過的外層會吸水。請先切片或分份，單層排在盤上凍硬避免黏在一起，再壓平裝袋。煮湯或火鍋時直接從冷凍下鍋——那正是海綿感會消失的地方。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍丟進滾湯。若真的解凍了，請放冷藏並當天煮掉，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 表面黏滑，或整袋黏成一團濕塊。
聞起來發酸或有發酵味，而不是淡淡的炸魚香。
包裝鼓脹有氣，或袋內積水。
長霉，或炸油出現油耗、油漆般的氣味。
tips: 向冷藏櫃購買，不要買常溫托盤上的。
拆開的包裝倒進有蓋容器並記下日期。
先鋪盤分份凍硬再裝袋。
在湯裡確實煮透，不要只是加熱。

faq.q: 甜不辣開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天。未開封則依包裝標示日期。
可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。解凍後偏海綿，所以請直接從冷凍下湯鍋或火鍋。

faq.q: 油炸過的表面算保護層嗎？
faq.a: 不算。那只是炸過的魚漿表層；裡面含水又低鹽，仍然需要冷藏。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷甜不辣壞掉了？
faq.a: 表面發黏、聞起來發酸、包裝脹氣，或油出現油耗味。請整份丟棄，不要切掉一層繼續吃。
